Loss report: gitlab -> gha
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.pull_request: pull_request: types: [opened, synchronize] (GitLab runs a merge request pipeline in the fork project, but a GHA pull_request run from a fork is a run of the base repository; the jobs that admit the pull request also run for fork pull requests)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
